fact: The ministers launched a census of built-up properties in Nouakchott, run by the military mapping directorate with UNDP and World Bank support over 12 to 14 months, to build a digital property database assigning each plot a unique identifier.
title: Recensement immobilier des terrains bâtis à Nouakchott : Une première étape utile, mais les terrains non bâtis restent un angle mort
